paragraphs.text:
You grab Sylvia’s feet just as she begins to slide down after Norman. 
You battle for a few seconds until you have both of them safely up 
on the cliff beside you. Your party can spare little time to celebrate 
its preservation. The odds are still against returning safely home.
Make a Luck roll: if you succeed, go to 513; if you fail, go to 324.
